bs.glaser.en15026: A timber or breathable build-up is outside the Glaser method, yet the sheet can pass; block it or add the EN 15026 pointer as a failing check.
bs.glaser.layer-subdivision: The verdict can flip when a layer is subdivided, so a pass may be wrong; make the subdivision a check of the verdict.
bs.glaser.rsi-f-low: A low internal surface resistance makes the surface check optimistic; hold R_si at the conventional value or check against it.

bs.heat-exchanger.condensation: Latent load is not in the duty when the coil can condense, so the duty is understated; add the latent check or block.

bs.insulation.bare-complies: The bare pipe meets a limit that thin insulation breaks; add the bare-pipe comparison as a check.
bs.insulation.critical-radius: Insulation below the critical radius carries more heat than the bare pipe; fail the heat-loss check against the bare pipe.
bs.insulation.h-se-condensation: A fixed h_se on a cold surface gives a thinner layer than the correlation, which is not conservative against condensation; compare with the correlation as a check.
bs.insulation.no-condensation-check: A cold surface with no dew-point margin is not checked for condensation; require the margin.

bs.pipe-expansion.friction: The anchor force holds no support friction unless mu and the weight are entered, so it is understated; require them or add the friction term.
bs.pipe-expansion.short-leg: The guided-cantilever model is not valid for a leg shorter than ten diameters; block or fail the model-range check.

bs.pipe-pump.eta-default: The default pump efficiency overstates small circulators, so the shaft power is understated; require the efficiency below 1 kW.
bs.pipe-pump.fittings: K is a turbulent value, so the fittings loss is understated below Re 4000; apply the low-Re rise or fail the range check.
bs.pipe-pump.fluid-cp: The results are those of water for a fluid with a different specific heat; require the custom fluid.
bs.pipe-pump.npsh-custom: NPSH_a is not computed for a custom fluid with no vapour pressure, so no NPSH check is made; require p_v_custom.
bs.pipe-pump.npsh-no-suction: With no suction segment NPSH_a carries no suction friction and is optimistic; require a suction segment.
bs.pipe-pump.plant-loss: Without an outlet head the pump head holds pipe friction only, so it is understated; require h_out.

bs.room-heat-loss.f-and-adjacent: An element with both reductions takes both, so its loss is understated; apply one reduction or block.
bs.room-heat-loss.mvhr-no-infiltration: A blank n_inf with an MVHR supply gives no infiltration loss at the outside temperature, so the loss is understated; require n_inf.

bs.sealed-system.v-pipe-default: The pipework volume is the 20 L default and is not linked, so a larger system gets an undersized vessel; require V_pipe.

elec.conductor-sizing.C_g: A missing grouping factor undersizes the conductor; require C_g or block with more than one grouped circuit.
elec.conductor-sizing.theta_a: An ambient above the reference with C_a left at 1 undersizes the conductor; require C_a.

elec.containment.P_lim: With no sidewall pressure limit the pressure is not checked; require it.
elec.containment.T_cab: A cable with no maximum pulling tension is not checked; require it.
elec.containment.jam: Three equal cables in a conduit near 1.05 D/d may jam while the fill check passes; fail the jam condition as a check.
elec.containment.n_bend: With no bend-radius multiple the bends are not checked; require it.

elec.fault-protection.adiabatic: With no disconnection time the adiabatic check is not made; require it.
elec.fault-protection.curve-range: Outside the points entered the disconnection time is bounded or not read, so the time check is not a proof; fail the check outside the curve.
elec.fault-protection.let-through: Disconnection below 0.1 s without a let-through I2t leaves the line conductor unchecked; require the let-through value.
elec.fault-protection.resistance: A conductor resistance factor below 1.05 understates R1 + R2 and Z_s; hold k_R at the standard factor.
elec.fault-protection.theta: Z_s at a temperature below the adiabatic initial one is understated; raise the temperature or fail the check.

elec.load-budget.battery-charge: The supply rating omits the battery charging power; add the charging term.
elec.load-budget.derate: Ambient above 40 degC with no derating overstates the supply capacity; require the derating.
elec.load-budget.load-defaults: A blank optional cell is taken as 1, which understates the heat and the starting peak; require the cells.
elec.load-budget.psu_bus: DC loads with no AC bus omit the power supply input from the bus currents and the transformer demand; require the bus.
elec.load-budget.rated-add: A linked machine with no rated power is sized on its duty power, and its rating can be higher; require the rating.

elec.motor-sizing.inertia-ratio: An inertia ratio above the stated multiple is advisory only; fail an inertia-ratio check.
elec.motor-sizing.overhauling: A load that drives the motor needs regeneration or braking the sheet does not check; add the check.
elec.motor-sizing.peak-at-speed: T_peak is compared as the stall peak although it falls toward top speed; compare against the curve or fail above 70 percent of n_max.
elec.motor-sizing.rated-speed: Without n_rated the rated power is not given and its check is not made; require n_rated.
elec.motor-sizing.return-move: The return stroke is not modelled for an inclined axis or a one-way process force; model it or block.

elec.motor-start.harmonics: A capacitor bank can resonate with harmonic loads; add the resonance order as a check.

elec.pcb-trace.copper: A copper weight outside 1 to 3 oz is outside the source curve fit; block outside the fit range.
elec.pcb-trace.input.I: A current above 35 A is outside the source curve fit; block outside the fit range.
elec.pcb-trace.rise: A rise below 10 K is outside the source curve fit; block outside the fit range.
elec.pcb-trace.width: A width above 10 mm is outside the source curve fit; block outside the fit range.

fp.accumulator.exponent-real: An exponent above 1 from 50 bar understates the gas volume; apply the real-gas correction.
fp.accumulator.link-basis: A linked gauge pressure entered as absolute reads one atmosphere low; convert the basis.
fp.accumulator.load-pressure: An emergency stroke without its load pressure leaves p_1 unchecked; require it.
fp.accumulator.process: The gas process chosen understates the volume; fail the check for the wrong process.
fp.accumulator.realgas: Above 200 bar the ideal-gas volume is too small; apply the real-gas factor or block.
fp.accumulator.realgas-window: In a narrow window above 100 bar the real-gas factor is larger than the compressibility factor; use the larger factor.

fp.oring-gland.expansion: The ring expands less than the groove metal, so the cold and hot ends are not the bounding cases; evaluate both and a mid point.
fp.oring-gland.installed-state: The operating range excludes 20 degC, so the installed squeeze can be smaller than the cold end; add the installed state.
fp.oring-gland.stretch: A stretch outside installation practice or the quadratic range is unreliable; fail the stretch check outside the range.
fp.oring-gland.worst-case: The stack worst case is not conservative for this geometry; use the exact corner.

mech.bearing-life.heavy-load: Above P = 0.5 C the rating-life equations lose accuracy; fail the check above that load.

mech.iso286-fit.interference-letter: The tabulated fundamental deviation from p to zc can be several micrometres larger, so the maximum interference is understated; use the table.

mech.mechanism.contact: The follower leaves the cam when its force falls below zero while the checks pass; add the contact-force check.

mech.shaft.key: The key check is not made until position, width, height and length are all entered; require them.
mech.shaft.key-hub: Without a hub strength the key bearing is checked against the key and the shaft only; require the hub strength.
mech.shaft.mass-weight: A carried mass with w_masses off leaves its weight out of the reactions and the deflection; include it or block.

mech.snap-fit.hold-unused: A force to hold without a number of latches leaves the holding check unmade; require the number.
mech.snap-fit.large-deflection: Linear beam theory under-predicts the strain beyond 0.3 of the length; use the large-deflection model.
mech.snap-fit.slender: A beam shorter than 5 thicknesses has an unreliable strain; block or fail below l/h = 5.
mech.snap-fit.small-angle: A torsion-bar twist above 20 degrees is outside the small-angle relation; block.
mech.snap-fit.thick-ring: A ring thicker than a tenth of its diameter is outside the thin-ring model; block.

mech.spring.fatigue-cycles: Goodman is a high-cycle relation and a life below 10^4 cycles is outside it; block or switch to a low-cycle method.
mech.spring.hook-fatigue: Extension-spring hook fatigue is not assessed; assess it or block.
mech.spring.surge: A surge frequency below 13 times the operating frequency is advisory only; fail the surge check.

mech.thick-cylinder.stability: External pressure on a thin wall can collapse before the stress limit; check the collapse pressure.

mech.tolerance-stack.few-contributors: With fewer than four contributors RSS is optimistic; report the worst case as governing.

struct.base-plate.alpha_basis: A concentration factor above 1 needs foundation geometry that is not verified; require the geometry.
struct.base-plate.alpha_bc: An anchor strength above 800 MPa is outside the alpha_bc formula; block outside 235 to 640 MPa.
struct.base-plate.anchorage-result: The anchorage is not assessed and u_max excludes it unless u_profis is entered; require u_profis.
struct.base-plate.f_y_thickness: One plate yield strength is used at every thickness, so a thicker plate is overstated; take f_y by thickness.
struct.base-plate.grout: beta_j = 2/3 needs a grout condition that is not verified; require it.
struct.base-plate.prying: The prying force is not in F_t,Ed, so the tension is understated; add it.

struct.connection-ec3.block: Block tearing needs the group force and both net areas; without them it is not checked; require them.
struct.connection-ec3.weld: The weld check needs a throat and a force per length; without them it is not made; require them.

struct.fillet-weld.long-joint: Lap welds longer than 150 a need the long-joint reduction, which the sheet does not apply; apply it.

struct.frame-2d.large-deflection: Above 1/50 of the member length the small-displacement assumption is doubtful; fail or block above it.

struct.lifting.beam-area: With no beam area the spreader utilisation is the lug utilisation only; require it.
struct.lifting.dishing: With no dishing limit the dishing check is not made; require it.
struct.lifting.k-svc: No service-class factor entered, 1.0 used; require it.

struct.ltb-interaction.c1-psi: C1 from the psi formula can exceed the exact elastic value by about 10 percent below psi = 0.25; use the exact value or cap it.
struct.ltb-interaction.table-b1: Table B.1 is for members not susceptible to torsional deformation, which an open I-section with chi_LT below 1 is unless restrained against twist; block or use Table B.2.

struct.plate-bending.large-deflection: Above w/t = 0.5 the small-deflection theory is not valid; block or fail above it.
struct.plate-bending.navier-converge: The Navier series reached its cap without converging; fail the convergence as a block.
struct.plate-bending.patch-thin: A patch smaller than the thickness is a concentrated load that thin-plate theory does not cover; block.
struct.plate-bending.ritz-converge: The Ritz solution reached its highest order without converging; fail the convergence as a block.
struct.plate-bending.ritz-frequency: The inverse iteration for the frequency did not settle; withhold the frequency.
struct.plate-bending.thin-plate: Below span/t = 10 the thin-plate theory over-states the stiffness; block or use a thick-plate method.
